## What's new

### One side panel for Files and AI usage
- The file browser and the AI token usage view now share a single right-side
  panel. Switch between them with the icons at the top of the panel, VS Code
  style. Arrow keys, Home and End move between the tabs.
- The toolbar has a single side-panel button that reopens the panel on the
  view you used last. `Ctrl+Shift+E` still toggles the Files view.
- The "AI token usage" entry was removed from the pane launcher (+) menu.
  It is still available from the side panel and the command palette, and
  saved layouts that contain a token usage pane still load.
- Your previous file dock / token dock width and open state carry over.

### Compact AI usage view
- Smaller, quieter type and a clear hierarchy: one line per quota window with
  a thin bar, the percentage and a short reset countdown (for example `2h 13m`).
- Bars turn yellow at 25% and red at 10% remaining.
- Exact reset time, last observed time and token breakdowns moved into
  tooltips.

### Fixes
- **Claude Code quota showed "—".** Anthropic's usage endpoint rate-limits
  frequent requests, and one failed request blanked the quota for 5 minutes.
  ymux now polls every 60 seconds instead of every 10, and retries after
  30 seconds when it has nothing to show yet.
- The toolbar usage button showed a raw translation key as its tooltip.

### Other
- New app icon.
- Microsoft Store packaging (MSIX) and the Store listing are in preparation.
- yMux is now licensed under the [MIT License](https://github.com/YoungMins/ymux/blob/main/LICENSE).
- READMEs (English, Korean, Japanese) rewritten for the current feature set,
  with a new [privacy policy](https://github.com/YoungMins/ymux/blob/main/packaging/microsoft-store/PRIVACY.md).
